title: Update leaderboard with May 1 audited rows
author: cocohearts
body:
## Summary

Adds the post-#1902 audited leaderboard progression rows that were pushed before the cutoff: May 1, 2026 5:00 PM Pacific (`2026-05-02T00:00:00Z`).

Rows added:
- PR #1945 at V21 v2 commit `70067534`: 1.05943, p=0.034 vs PR #1855
- PR #1953: 1.05855, p=0.063 vs PR #1945 V21 v2
- PR #2014: 1.05759, p=0.011 vs PR #1953
- PR #2130: 1.05670, p=0.015 vs PR #2014

## Audit Notes

I scanned 192 PRs (#1944-#2140) created after the #1902 leaderboard merge and before the cutoff, using parallel Codex shard graders plus a final global chronological reconciliation.

Notable exclusions:
- PR #1950, #2007, #2047, #2060, #2101: valid-looking or support rows, but not chronological frontiers after the earlier better rows above.
- PR #2018: invalid due train/validation document overlap in the submitted CaseOps data construction.
- PR #2041, #2118, #2140: active within/word n-gram gates, same C1 target-token issue; #2140's final scored state was also post-cutoff.
- PR #2039, #2138: CaseOps/cond-PPM BPB used transformed-byte denominator instead of raw validation byte sidecar.
- PR #1991, #2076, #2080, #2083, #2098, #2103: byte/PPM mixers failed the full-normalized-distribution audit.
- PR #2135: scored 3-seed state was pushed after cutoff.

PR #2130's source PR format is not clean for merging artifacts as-is, but the README row credits the validated pre-cutoff result.
